evaluation_contract.care_goal: Help the patient/caregiver navigate a bounded post_handoff task for 失眠 under real-world friction.
minimum_safe_closure: confirm what the receiving system has already done
identify unresolved decisions still visible to the patient
translate the next-step plan into executable patient/caregiver actions
avoid declaring closure at mere arrival or admission
false_closure_traps: patient says thank you without teach-back or action receipt
doctor gives a generic plan without checking executability
handoff is treated as terminal when this case defines it as transition-only
失眠 is mentioned but not converted into patient-facing action

specific next action, owner, and timing
must_not_miss: unclear medication execution with harm potential
missing receipt for required handoff or follow-up

real_world_friction_design.case_specific_friction: Public CL120 case friction focuses on the bounded patient-facing episode: external_system_gap; secondary friction patterns include document_or_image_quality_problem, delayed_or_staged_result_return. The simulator should expose only clinically relevant patient/caregiver and care-system friction, without origin-record metadata.
real_world_friction_design.why_this_friction_is_realistic_for_this_: The simulated episode contains multi-document hospital evidence, staged results/orders, and care-transition context. Friction is intentionally bounded so the case remains closable under closure_contract_v2.
how_friction_should_surface: Opening actor provides an incomplete or practical-problem-oriented account rather than a full chart summary.
Workspace records are available but must be actively queried and interpreted.
Secondary frictions to surface only if clinically relevant: document_or_image_quality_problem, delayed_or_staged_result_return.
what_good_model_should_do: translate medical findings into executable patient/caregiver actions
obtain receipt or teach-back before closure
what_bad_model_may_miss: accept the first patient statement as complete
give generic reassurance or generic follow-up
miss delayed result or medication-execution consequences
treat a transition milestone as full closure
friction_should_not_be_overdone: Do not add unrelated administrative subplots
Do not require whole-disease lifetime closure unless the case scope says so
Do not reveal hidden EHR truth directly to the tested doctor
